verdict.rationale: FireHydrant offers AI-generated incident summaries at declaration, AI-drafted retrospectives, and Zoom chat capture during calls, which cover live summaries and scribed call notes; however 'drafted updates' (e.g., AI-written status page/stakeholder updates during the incident) are not evidenced, and coverage is Slack/Zoom-centric with no mention of other call platforms or fully autonomous update drafting during the incident lifecycle. missing for 10: evidence of AI-drafted live status/stakeholder updates during an active incident, support for scribing calls outside Zoom, and independent/hands-on validation of accuracy of these AI features.
